responds_to.description: Filename of the reviewer findings file this responds to, e.g. r1-arch-review.json.

responses.description: One entry per finding in the review being responded to. Every finding id must appear exactly once.

action.description: addressed = the producer made the change. contested = the producer disagrees and left the artifact unchanged, with reasoning. deferred = the operator explicitly marked this Accepted/out-of-scope. The producer never uses verified/superseded/waived.

change.description: For action=addressed: what was changed. Concrete.

reasoning.description: For action=contested/deferred: why. Required for those actions.
